strategies.title: [inflate-reoptimize-continuation] Alternating radius-inflation sweep with positi
strategies.plan:

Replacement scope: Replace the final "Final re-polish of the incumbent" block (the single `_refine(best_c, best_r)` call before the safety shrink) with an alternating inflation/re-optimization loop; keep everything upstream (seeds, multistart, archive) unchanged.

strategies.title: [exact-lp-radius-assignment] Optimal radius assignment via linear programming
strategies.plan:
Mechanism family: exact-lp-radius-assignment
Replacement scope: Replace `compute_max_radii` entirely (both its direct call sites in `construct_packing` and its uses inside `_refine`) with an exact LP solver; keep the seed atlas, `_refine`, and multistart loop unchanged.

strategies.plan:

Replacement scope: The seed-generation block inside `construct_packing` (the `seeds` list and its builders `_hex_seed`, `_graded_seed`, `_dominant_seed`, `_sheared_seed`, `_transposed_hex_seed`, `_dominant_corner_seed`); the `_refine`/`compute_max_radii` machinery and the weighted-sweep phase are kept unchanged.

Gain mechanism: The incumbent's row seeds are straight horizontal rows; the unit square's boundary curves away from a straight row at its ends, so end circles in straight rows sit farther from the walls than a bent row would, wasting wall-adjacent slack. The new degree of freedom is row curvature: each row of counts m is placed on a circular arc of sagitta s (parameter swept over s ∈ {0.01, 0.02, 0.03} with both signs), with row k's arc centered near the square center and its endpoints pulled toward the left/right walls. Concretely, for row k with count m and base level y_k (reusing the incumbent's row-tangency vertical spacing), place circle j at x = 0.5 + (j - (m-1)/2)·d_k, y = y_k + s·(1 - (2·(j-(m-1)/2)/(m-1))²)·sign, where d_k is chosen so end circles sit at distance ≈ 1/(2m) from the side walls. Curvature sign alternates so rows nest into the square's rounded interior footprint. Replacement scope: The perimeter subsystem of the seed builders: replace `_graded_seed`'s corner-plus-edge placement (the four corner circles, the 3-per-side edge circles, and their interpolation weights) with a closed-chain construction; the 10-circle interior stagger and all downstream refinement phases are unchanged.

Gain mechanism: The incumbent places edge circles by heuristic proportional interpolation, so edge chains are not tangent to their neighbors — each edge circle sits with slack to the corner circle and the next edge circle, and that slack is pure lost radius (an edge circle's radius is wall-limited, so any gap to its in-chain neighbors is unrealized sum). The new construction places the perimeter as a single closed chain of 16 circles (4 corners + 3 per side) where consecutive chain members are exactly tangent: corner radius r_c at each corner, and along each side the three edge circles have radii r_e and centers at cumulative arc positions x_{i+1} = x_i + 2·sqrt(r_i·r_{i+1})... concretely, along the bottom wall the chain from corner radius r_L to corner radius r_R is built by choosing two intermediate radii (r_L·ρ, r_R·ρ with ρ swept over {0.55, 0.65, 0.75}) and placing centers so consecutive circles are exactly tangent on the wall line: x_{i+1} = x_i + 2·sqrt(r_i r_{i+1}) (the wall-tangent chain condition). strategies.plan:

Replacement scope: Replace the final "residual polish + weighted-objective degeneracy sweep" phase in `construct_packing()` (the block after the multistart loop, from `best_c, best_r = _refine(best_c, best_r)` through the weight-generator loop) with a deterministic coordinate-descent pass over individual circle centers.
